newsitem.title: USA: Municipal sales total $352 mln for week of Nov 25.
newsitem.headline: Municipal sales total $352 mln for week of Nov 25.

text.p: Scheduled competitive and negotiated municipal bond sales are expected to total $352 million in 49 offerings for the week of November 25, according to Reuters Municipal Bond Information Group.
Competitive sales total $233.8 million in 38 issues. The largest is a $39.4 million Newark, N.J., on November 26.
The busiest day in the competitive sector is on Tuesday, when $124 million of issues in 21 offerings are slated for sale.
On Monday, $103 million of issues in 15 offerings are slated for sale, with a $30 million Johnson County, Kan., Unified School District No. 512 issue topping the list.
Negotiated sales total $117.9 million in 11 offerings for the week. The largest is a $23 million Lincolnton, N.C., through Robinson-Humphery Co.
There are eight issues totaling $588 million on the Reuters day-to-day calendar, meaning underwriters have indicated they may price them during the week of November 25 depending on market conditions.
